_meta.description: Four recognizable case types with their status lifecycles and two document types, shipped on every install: Building Permit (Baugenehmigung), Grant Application (Förderantrag), Citizen Complaint (Bürgerbeschwerde) and Freedom of Information Request (IFG). The case types and statuses carry Dutch and English labels, so OpenRegister answers each reader in their language. Objects reference each other by @self.slug; the importer resolves slugs to ids. The English example cases on these types are optional example data in demo.d/46-english-cases.json, loaded only on request.
